specification_compliance: I5: the beforeunload handler is armed while an entry is unfinished (leaveConfirmationArmed = !leaveSuppressed && hasUnfinished) and is disarmed before a confirmed Lock. This matches the invariant as written.
I13: UploadProgress returns null for sheet half/full (UploadProgress.tsx:38). The bottom offset is the max of the peek strip and the mini-player offsets (bottomChromeOffset).
potential_unspecified_behavior: If lockApi() rejects after a confirmed Lock (Sidebar.tsx:57-61), leaveSuppressed stays true for the rest of the session. The leave-page confirmation then never arms again, even though the app stays unlocked and uploads continue. The rejection is also unhandled. I5 says that after a confirmed Lock the handler does not cancel, so this is arguably in spec. Recovery after a failed lock is unspecified.
regression_risks: MINI_PLAYER_HEIGHT_PX/GAP_PX in bottomChrome.ts are duplicated from the class literals in MiniPlayerContainer.tsx. If one changes without the other, the drawer will overlap the mini-player, and neither a unit test nor the e2e fixture would catch it.
test_coverage: The upload-drawer e2e test measures a hand-written fixture. It does not cover bottomChromeOffset or the half/full early return in UploadProgress.
